summary: Build offshore control, SIMOPS, and reporting skills in 5 days. Train with practical templates, platform scenarios, and action-ready tools.
lede: Offshore operations management coordinates production, maintenance, safety, logistics, and integrity across platform activities. The course is for professionals responsible for offshore work execution, platform integrity, and cross-functional coordination. Learners practice reviewing permit-to-work packs, planning simultaneous operations, coordinating maintenance and marine interfaces, and preparing shift handovers and integrity reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage offshore work execution, platform integrity, and cross-functional coordination on fixed or floating assets.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with offshore production, maintenance, or marine support environments. Prior experience in platform operations, shift supervision, mechanical or process maintenance, HSE coordination, or offshore logistics is recommended. No coding is required. The course is structured at an intermediate level and treats advanced topics such as digital PTW, CMMS-supported planning, and integrity dashboard use at operational application level rather than engineering design depth.
